title: ProteinMPNN noise robustness
description: Redesign a structure at several backbone noise levels and measure sequence recovery.

structure_path.title: 结构文件路径
structure_path.description: PDB file whose coordinates are perturbed; ProteinMPNN needs atom names, so a path is used instead of the atom table.

chains.title: 设计链
chains.description: Comma-separated chain IDs forwarded as --pdb_path_chains; empty designs every chain.

noise_levels.title: 噪声水平
noise_levels.description: Comma-separated Gaussian coordinate noise standard deviations in angstroms; 0 keeps the original coordinates.

replicates.title: 重复次数
replicates.description: Independent noise draws per level, each redesigned and reported as its own output row.

num_seq_per_target.title: 每条链序列数
num_seq_per_target.description: Number of designs sampled per replicate.

sampling_temp.title: 采样温度
sampling_temp.description: ProteinMPNN sampling temperature as a decimal string.

seed.title: 随机种子
seed.description: Random state for the coordinate noise and the designer sampling.

proteinmpnn_path.title: ProteinMPNN 路径
proteinmpnn_path.description: Official ProteinMPNN checkout holding protein_mpnn_run.py; falls back to OPERON_PROTEINMPNN_PATH.

weights_path.title: 权重目录
weights_path.description: Directory holding v_48_*.pt; defaults to proteinmpnn_path/vanilla_model_weights.

python_executable.title: Python 可执行文件
python_executable.description: Interpreter used to launch the official runner; empty uses the running interpreter.

device.title: 设备
device.description: Run the designer on CPU or CUDA.

timeout_seconds.title: 超时时间
timeout_seconds.description: Seconds allowed for each designer invocation.

output.title: 输出名称
output.description: Output slot name for the robustness table.
